attempts.summary: Created opsbot on both node1 and node2 (password-locked accounts), generated an ed25519 keypair for opsbot on node1, installed its public key in node2's opsbot authorized_keys, and added Match User opsbot blocks (PasswordAuthentication no, AuthenticationMethods publickey) to sshd_config.d on both nodes. Verified opsbot@node1 can SSH to opsbot@node2 with the key and run commands, and that password-only auth attempts are rejected on both nodes. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured boot_id + health baselines, rebooted node1 then node2 one at a time, confirmed boot_id changed on each, and reverified opsbot account, SSH keys/authorized_keys, and cross-node key-based SSH access all survived both restarts.
